caption: The drawing depicts a wooden-framed sofa with light green upholstery. The upholstery features an intricate, repeating floral damask pattern in a slightly darker shade of green, covering the backrest, seat, and the interior sides of the sofa. The frame appears to be made of dark brown wood, visible along the top edge, arms, and base of the sofa, with carved details along the top back. The sofa has six turned wooden legs, each with a brass or gold-colored castor at the bottom. Above the sofa, there are two rectangular decorative elements, each outlined in black. Both rectangles contain line-drawn motifs: the left one consists of a ribbon tied around what appear to be crossed sticks or branches, while the right one features a ribbon tied around a bundle of leaves or stalks. The background is a plain beige color, and there is a signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Sofa
